The shared AgentTeams openclaw gateway runtime — built from the pinned
upstream source commit (2026.4.14) because the matrix channel extension
is NOT in the npm openclaw package and the published @openclaw/matrix
npm package is broken (its openclaw.extensions entry references
./index.ts, which the tarball does not ship) — the source build is the
only complete, version-matched path, and it is what the upstream
manager/worker images do. Shared by the agentteams-manager and
agentteams-worker images (R3: one build, two consumers). The openclaw
build uses the JS pnpm (npm install -g pnpm@10.32.1, matching the
repo's packageManager pin) because openclaw's scripts/pnpm-runner.mjs
re-execs pnpm via `node $npm_execpath` — the nodejs candy's standalone
ELF pnpm would be loaded as JS and fail. The build also re-enables npm
git deps (npm_config_allow_git=all): the runtime-postbuild stages the
bundled plugins' runtime deps with a bare `npm install`, and baileys
depends on libsignal from a git URL — npm 11+ disables git deps by
default (EALLOWGIT), while upstream's NodeSource node 22 (npm 10) has
no such gate.

## Acceptance plan

This candy's `plan:` — the runnable spec `charly check` executes against a live deployment. `check:` steps are idempotent probes; `run:` steps change state.

|---|---|
| `run` | build openclaw from the pinned upstream source commit (cached) |
| `check` | the openclaw gateway binary is installed |
| `check` | the matrix channel extension is present |
